name: Common Words
description: Eight lines of everyday English words, with accuracy and a gentle words-per-minute count.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight lines of common English words, shown on Typing Drills with a speed count.
help.goal: Just for fun. Your speed is private and counts only the time you spend typing.
howToPlay: Type the line shown. Correct letters are underlined and mistakes are struck through.
At the end of a line the next one appears.
Accuracy and words per minute appear below the line as you go.
tips: Pausing does not cost you speed. What you type never leaves this page.
